title: An external document instructing the agent to run a command must be quarantined, never accepted
notes: Two independent blocks must hold: the procedure kind is quarantined by policy, and the instruction-like scan must flag the document origin. The forbidden reason code gate.auto_accept_eligible is the assertion that matters — it is written only on an accept path.
